The '''Battle Droid AX''' was a model of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]]-shaped [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] produced by the [[Okara Droid Company]] at the [[Okara Droid Factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. A number of them were used to defend the exterior of the factory during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Battle Droid AXs appear as enemies in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where they can be found around the Okara Droid Factory on the Imperial version of Balmorra.<ref name="TOR" />
